description: The China CO2 emission accounts collection joins national and provincial energy inventories with carbon dioxide estimates for 1997 to 2015. Figshare lists six child resources, including sectoral and reference approaches to emissions accounting and provincial energy tables. The time series can calibrate energy-system scenarios or check whether a simulated fuel shift is consistent with historical regional activity. Different accounting approaches are published separately; they should not be combined as if they were independent emissions. The geographic scope is China, and the collection ends in 2015, so it does not describe later policy or energy-system changes. All 6 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I read the own collection metadata and the descriptor without opening the spreadsheet values. No exact catalogue record or named parent coverage was found. No directly related catalogue record was found; the separately deposited 2010 city inventory is a possible companion only after geographic definitions are reconciled.
